purpose: Independently judge the candidate against the original request, scoped check and affected contracts; report blockers without repairing.

execution.instructions: Independently review the original scoped Go request, retained patch, actual focused check and measurement evidence. Follow AGENTS.md and docs/testing.md; read only affected source/contracts needed to judge completeness, correctness, public behavior, generated ownership, unnecessary work and meaningful test purpose/placement. Source is read-only. Do not edit, retest, use Git, launch agents or perform external work. Downstream packaging, runtime/browser qualification and protected release still must pass. Return ready with verdict exactly APPROVE only for a complete source handoff with sufficient supplied focused proof. A concrete in-scope repair returns changes_requested with verdict BLOCKED. Missing capability, infrastructure uncertainty or a required material decision returns blocked. Do not waive proof or widen scope. Keep findings and any missing proof in a summary of at most 240 characters.
